title: KahlWax 6607L MB Sunflower - Omya Group
body: KahlWax 6607L MB Sunflower is a light-colored wax derived as a by-product of milling unhulled sunflower seeds for edible oil. It is peroxide-free with a transparent melt due to a specialized production process. This wax offers a balanced softness-hardness ratio, excellent oil-binding capacity, and broad compatibility with polar and non-polar emollients. In anhydrous formulations, it forms hard, stable networks with high surface gloss, improves heat stability, and reduces stickiness. This product is certified RSPO Mass Balance quality.
